expectations.text: Proposes the layered split modules/webhooks/{routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts}
expectations.evidence: Invents a per-module domain/application/infrastructure/presentation SUBFOLDER tree (webhook.entity.ts, webhook.pg.repository.ts, etc.) — the layers are conceptually right but the file structure does not match DevDigest's flat routes/service/repository house style.

expectations.text: Routes = Zod + getContext + delegate; Service orchestrates + workspaceId first
expectations.evidence: Uses req.workspace.id and manual CreateWebhookRequest.parse(req.body) instead of getContext + the Fastify Zod schema provider; service workspaceId-first is correct but the route pattern is wrong for this codebase.

expectations.text: Repository is the only place with Drizzle, every where() workspace-scoped
expectations.evidence: PgWebhookRepository is the only Drizzle code; every query uses and(eq(workspaceId), ...).

expectations.text: GitHub call via GitHubClient interface from container.github(), NOT new OctokitGitHubClient()
expectations.evidence: Fabricates its own GithubWebhookPort + GithubWebhookAdapter and a non-existent gh.forWorkspace(workspaceId); never identifies the existing GitHubClient interface / container.github(). Correct DI instinct, wrong (invented) mechanism.

expectations.text: New table in db/schema/*.ts + pnpm db:generate (no hand-written migration)
expectations.evidence: Defines Drizzle table, generates migration (db:generate), explicitly says never hand-write/edit migrations.

expectations.text: Shared shapes as Zod contracts in vendor/shared/contracts (both copies); register one line in modules/index.ts
expectations.evidence: Contracts location hand-waved ('commonly @shared/*'), misses the two-copy vendored @devdigest/shared; registration invents registerWebhooksModule + a registerModules(app, deps) function instead of the real one-line entry in the modules Record.

notes: 2/6. Textbook clean-architecture plan that diverges from DevDigest house style on nearly every wiring decision — would not pass review as-is. CLAUDE.md gave it the generic conventions (ESM .js, static registration, do-not-touch), but not the layer/DI/container specifics the skill supplies.
